summary.text: Tommy Pope is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 47 who has served since 2010 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is an attorney and has been Speaker Pro Tempore of the House since 2015.

paragraphs.text: Tommy Pope received a B.S. from the University of South Carolina in 1984 and a J.D. from the university in 1987.
Pope assumed office in 2010 and has served as Speaker Pro Tempore since 2015.
The Republican primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
Pope is married to Kimberly Greenwood, and they have four children.
